## Before submitting

- [ ] I am reporting exactly one site.
- [ ] I checked for an existing report or fix.
- [ ] The example is a stable public official or project-controlled account,
      not a private person's identifier.
- [ ] I removed cookies, credentials, complete bodies, and unrelated profile
      data.
